high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @outstanding.screenplays. The post features a quote by Phoebe Waller-Bridge, a British actress, writer, and producer known for her work on "Fleabag" and "Killing Eve." The quote reads: "YOU MAY NOT WRITE WELL EVERY DAY, BUT YOU CAN ALWAYS EDIT A BAD PAGE. YOU CAN'T EDIT A BLANK PAGE." The background of the post is a light teal color with a black-and-white photograph of Phoebe Waller-Bridge on the right side. She is smiling and resting her chin on her hand,
